description: The add-on's own part of the quick filter of a mail tab. The script loads when the first verb is called.

functions.name: set
functions.description: Adds a List-Id filter, a same-day filter or both to the filters the mail tab shows, and shows the filter bar. Answers when the search ends: true, or false when it still ran after 5 seconds. A later mailTabs.setQuickFilter removes them.
